description: Use when you need to screen a list of wallet addresses against the official OFAC SDN list in one call: up to 25 per POST (0x, BTC, TRX, SOL and others as OFAC lists them). Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (POST /sanctions/check/batch, $0.125 per call), with the response schema and an example; POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For one address or a name use sanctions_screening.

addresses.description: 1 to 25 crypto addresses to screen (as written on their chains); duplicates are removed; names are not accepted
